source: UN Environment Programme / WMO Ozone Assessment 2022

slides.headline: The world fixed the hole in the sky
slides.subline: **The ozone layer** is healing. Here is how humanity pulled it off.

slides.body: In the 1980s scientists found a growing hole in the **ozone layer** over Antarctica. It shields us from harmful ultraviolet rays. The culprit: chemicals in [[fridges and spray cans]].
In **1987** nearly every country signed the Montreal Protocol to phase those chemicals out. It is the first UN treaty ever ratified by [[every country]] on Earth.
The UN-backed 2022 assessment found about **99%** of banned ozone-depleting substances have been phased out. The layer is [[on the mend]].
Experts project recovery to 1980 levels around **2040** for most of the world, about **2045** over the Arctic and about [[2066]] over Antarctica.
The proof that the world can solve a global problem together. Which problem should we tackle next? Tell us below.
